top_signals.title: Trip.com Fined in China Antitrust Case as Price Wars Continue
top_signals.summary: China’s months-long antitrust probe into Trip.com Group Ltd. ended with a multi-billion-yuan penalty on the nation’s largest online travel agency, but the action does little to ease the fierce price wars gripping the domestic hotel sector.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
